scope: Static prompt/encoding evidence for this frozen evaluation source; not measured model performance or a causal estimate.

findings.prompt: task_tuning.py uses the same A-style binary edge hint for NAS101 A/B/C.
findings.B: Actual edge inputs are reversed column bit-ID selectors, not A row-major binary edge flags.
findings.C: Actual edge inputs are row-order priority values selecting top-k edges, not binary edge flags.
findings.decision: Retain original paper/repository hints for the main matrix; the candidate hint patch is not applied. Interpret B/C results with this limitation; no C failure is inferred from static evidence.
